metadata.description: Carbon emission factors for agricultural activities based on IPCC guidelines
metadata.source: IPCC 2019 Refinement, Indian Network for Climate Change Assessment (INCCA)
metadata.scope: Agricultural carbon footprint calculation for Indian farming systems

fertilizer_production.description: Emissions from manufacturing of synthetic fertilizers

fertilizer_application.description: Direct and indirect N2O emissions from fertilizer use
fertilizer_application.unit: kg CO2-eq per kg N applied

fuel_combustion.description: CO2 emissions from diesel/petrol use in farm machinery

crop_residue_burning.description: Emissions from burning of crop residues
crop_residue_burning.unit: kg CO2-eq per kg dry matter burned

livestock.unit: kg CO2-eq per animal per year

npk_complex.description: Average emissions for NPK complex fertilizers

direct_n2o.description: Direct N2O emissions from nitrogen fertilizer application
direct_n2o.calculation: EF1 = 0.01 kg N2O-N/kg N applied × 44/28 × 298 GWP

indirect_n2o_volatilization.description: Indirect N2O from NH3 and NOx volatilization

indirect_n2o_leaching.description: Indirect N2O from nitrate leaching and runoff

diesel.description: CO2 emissions from diesel combustion in tractors and pumps
diesel.source: IPCC 2006, Bureau of Energy Efficiency India

petrol.description: CO2 emissions from petrol combustion in small engines

cng.description: CO2 emissions from compressed natural gas

lpg.description: CO2 emissions from liquefied petroleum gas

india_grid_average.description: Average CO2 emissions from Indian electricity grid

kerala.description: Low emissions due to high hydro and renewable energy

gujarat.description: Mix of thermal, gas, and renewable energy

rajasthan.description: Increasing solar and wind energy share

rice_straw.description: Emissions from burning rice straw in fields

wheat_straw.description: Emissions from burning wheat straw in fields

sugarcane_trash.description: Emissions from burning sugarcane leaves and tops

cotton_stalks.description: Emissions from burning cotton plant residues

cattle_dairy.description: Annual methane emissions from dairy cattle

cattle_non_dairy.description: Annual methane emissions from non-dairy cattle

poultry.description: Annual methane emissions from poultry (per bird)

fym_application.description: Carbon sequestration from farmyard manure application
fym_application.unit: kg CO2-eq per kg FYM applied

compost_application.unit: kg CO2-eq per kg compost applied

vermicompost_application.unit: kg CO2-eq per kg vermicompost applied

crop_residue_incorporation.description: Carbon sequestration from crop residue incorporation
crop_residue_incorporation.unit: kg CO2-eq per kg dry residue incorporated

conventional_tillage.description: Carbon loss from intensive tillage operations
conventional_tillage.unit: kg CO2-eq per hectare per operation

reduced_tillage.description: Reduced carbon loss from minimal tillage
reduced_tillage.unit: kg CO2-eq per hectare per operation

no_tillage.unit: kg CO2-eq per hectare per year

flood_irrigation.unit: kg CO2-eq per hectare-cm water applied

sprinkler_irrigation.description: Higher energy use but better water efficiency
sprinkler_irrigation.unit: kg CO2-eq per hectare-cm water applied

drip_irrigation.description: Highest energy use but maximum water efficiency
drip_irrigation.unit: kg CO2-eq per hectare-cm water applied

groundwater_pumping.unit: kg CO2-eq per kWh electricity used

canal_water.description: Minimal emissions from gravity-fed canal irrigation
canal_water.unit: kg CO2-eq per hectare-cm water applied

continuously_flooded.description: CH4 emissions from continuously flooded rice fields
continuously_flooded.unit: kg CH4 per hectare per day

intermittently_flooded.description: Reduced CH4 emissions with alternate wetting and drying
intermittently_flooded.unit: kg CH4 per hectare per day

upland_rice.description: Minimal CH4 emissions from upland rice cultivation
upland_rice.unit: kg CH4 per hectare per day

pre_harvest_burning.description: Emissions from pre-harvest burning of sugarcane
pre_harvest_burning.unit: kg CO2-eq per tonne cane burned

trees_on_farmland.description: Annual carbon sequestration from farm trees
trees_on_farmland.unit: kg CO2-eq per tree per year

boundary_plantation.description: Carbon sequestration from boundary tree plantation
boundary_plantation.unit: kg CO2-eq per meter of boundary per year

legume_cover_crops.description: Carbon sequestration from legume cover crops
legume_cover_crops.unit: kg CO2-eq per hectare per year

grass_cover_crops.description: Carbon sequestration from grass cover crops
grass_cover_crops.unit: kg CO2-eq per hectare per year

calculation_steps: Identify all emission sources on the farm
Collect activity data (fertilizer use, fuel consumption, etc.)
Calculate total emissions in CO2 equivalents

fertilizer_management: Precision application based on soil testing
Integration of organic and inorganic sources
soil_health: Crop residue incorporation instead of burning
water_management: Alternate wetting and drying in rice
